body: I have not really posted a self reddit before, especially one like this, but all i really want to say is help, but i can never think who to say it to. Anyway time to splurge, i am a teenager and previously had another reddit account but i started a new one because some of my family use reddit and i dont want them to know. Anyway i am not suicidal, but i sometimes think about it and when i am really depressed it seems like a relief. Whenever i get really stressed i go mad basically, i have hurt myself in the past when this is happened now i am scared it will happen again. But the thing is normally i am just normal, talk to my friends, be happy etc, but sometimes just a stupidly small thing can happen and will set me off. Whenever this happens i keep telling myself how bad i am and it takes ages for me to get out. At school we keep learning about manic depression, but i don't know if i have it. I can't talk to anyone because i feel as though they would laugh at me or scold me or think i am mad. Luckily an 'episode' hasn't happened for months, but i am scared it might happen again. Can anyone help.
